name: feature
description: New capability, or a change to how something works

name: bug
description: Something is broken or shows the wrong thing

name: user-feedback
description: Raised by a pilot (help ticket, Discord, meeting); add feature or bug once triaged

name: security
description: Access control, secrets, or hardening (exploit details stay private)

name: tech-debt
description: Cleanup, refactor, upgrade or tooling: no change pilots should notice

name: needs-design
description: Significant feature without a design or a person's sign-off to skip one
